[new component]{.chip .built} [enforced rule]{.chip .hardened} Entry 60 · milestone M4
:::

The preceding refinement changed the width-search basis together with the final
solve basis. Its large flux differences therefore could not distinguish those
effects. A bounded factorial diagnostic now varies each setting while holding
the other fixed, preserving every remaining saved input.

The reporting checks pass ([54 focused synthetic checks pass in each mode, including separated basis effects, interactions, signed channels, incomplete evidence and consumed-control drift; 553 unchanged recorded checks are retained separately]{.claim}[C-204](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-204){.cid .st-tested}). They exercise separated effects,
interactions, signed flux, missing evidence and disagreement with consumed controls.
The original output driver now records native selected widths and search growth
alongside the retained mode spectra. It links the same pinned solver library.
Preparation checks the single-pass conditions needed to interpret the registers;
the wrapper's missing diagnostics remain an explicit limit.

The package is frozen, verified from its actual execution directory and submitted
once under the standing bounded-compute and diagnostic-storage permissions.
Controls reproduce the preceding basis cells before scientific interpretation.
Submission does not establish convergence. The current model, guard and acceptance
criteria remain fixed; the separate feedback-sampling proposal remains unrun.
